next_step_summary: PR #248 extends the populated provider-independent Question Engine inventory with the recurring pre-signing condition / AS-IS / defects / damage-evidence mechanism. The bounded slice keeps entry baseline, AS-IS/inspection wording, pre-existing defects, damage versus ordinary wear, repair mechanics, return condition, and referenced condition/inventory documents as separate contract-fact questions. Missing referenced documents remain explicit dependencies rather than guessed content. It adds no statutory repair runtime, court-outcome logic, post-dispute evidence mode, conditional trigger runtime, LLM/provider integration, UI, OCR, Android, serverless, storage, dependencies, permissions, workflows, or network access. The next bounded inventory slice is termination + cure + notice + physical-eviction distinction.
